---
title: Potatoes
id: MAR-0095
lang: en
source_lang: it
servings: 4
time_min: 70
difficulty: medium
---
## Ingredients
- 400 g mussels
- 220 g rice
- 2 onion
- 400 g cherry tomatoes
- 20 g parsley
- 1 garlic clove
- 400 g potato
- 4 tablespoons extra virgin olive oil
- to taste salt and pepper
## Method
1. Peel the potatoes, wash them, and then slice them into thin slices.
2. Cut the cherry tomatoes in half.
3. Crush the garlic clove and peel it.
4. Wash the parsley, remove the stems, and chop it with the garlic.
5. Peel and slice the onions.
6. Scrape the mussels, remove the beard, open them with a knife, discarding the empty shell as you go, and strain their liquid.
7. Grease a large ovenproof pan with a tablespoon of oil.
8. Arrange a first layer of onions on the bottom, sprinkle with some of the garlic and parsley mixture, then add a layer with half of the cherry tomatoes, then half of the potatoes, slightly overlapping them to form another layer, and season with salt and pepper.
9. Spread the rice on top, then the mussels and the remaining cherry tomatoes, sprinkle with the parsley mixture, and continue with the remaining potatoes.
10. Season with salt and pepper, then add enough water to the mussel liquid to obtain 7 dl (or in any case a quantity sufficient to cover the preparation).
11. Finish with the remaining oil, cover the dish, and bake at 180 °C for 20 minutes.
12. Remove the lid and continue cooking for about 15-20 minutes, adding boiling water if necessary.
